panels.description: A Halyard worker submits a repaired filtration component at a public contribution kiosk. Leave upper kiosk space.
The kiosk assigns ownership to Caldera House and pays a creator bonus while omitting the maker's name. Leave upper display space.
Alex and Ada open Adrian's public registry entry. Halyard fabrication towers reflect in the glass. Leave upper display space.
Alex looks at the locked estate record while Ada studies him. Leave upper registry space.
